title: Collection Value Trend Over Time
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| timechart span=1mon sum(market_value) as value by category
description: Trends the estimated market value of your collections month by month, so you watch your hobby appreciate (or not).
value: A value trend turns a shelf of stuff into a tracked asset, revealing which parts of a collection are actually gaining.
implementation: Ingest catalogue values from Discogs/BrickLink into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and trend value by category.
visualization: Line chart of collection value over time by category.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how much your collections are worth over time, so you can see them grow in value.
